item.title: A successful Git branching model
item.description:
Why git?

For a thorough discussion on the pros and cons of Git compared to centralized source code control systems. As a developer, I prefer Git above all other tools around today. Git really changed the way developers think of merging and branching. From the classic CVS/Subversion world I came from, merging/branching has always been considered a bit scary and something you only do every once in a while.

As a consequence of its simplicity and repetitive nature, branching and merging are no longer something to be afraid of. Version control tools are supposed to assist in branching/merging more than anything else.

item.title: 点击热力图分析
item.description:
🔥 博客点击热力图分析

💡 使用说明

  • 查看热力图: 在任何博客页面按住 Alt 键即可查看该页面的热力图
  • 分析数据: 在这个页面查看详细的点击统计数据
  • 清除数据: 点击分析页面中的"清除所有数据"按钮
  • 导出数据: 点击"导出数据"下载JSON格式的点击数据

🎯 功能特性

  • 实时追踪: 自动记录用户点击行为
  • 彩色热力图: 红(高频) → 黄(中频) → 蓝(低频)
  • 数据统计: 显示总点击次数、分析页面数、平均点击等
  • 隐私保护: 数据仅存储在本地浏览器中

热力图功能帮助你了解博客的哪些区域最受用户关注！
